title: Denisovan jaw from the Tibetan Plateau
place: Baishiya Karst Cave, Xiahe, Gansu, China
summary: Proteins from a jawbone found in 1980 identified it as Denisovan and over 160,000 years old, from a high, low-oxygen cave on the edge of the Tibetan Plateau.
why: Puts Denisovans on the high Tibetan Plateau, home of the Denisovan-derived altitude gene.
